films.title: Signal Harbor
films.overview: A stranded astronaut on a damaged cargo ship uses a repeating radio signal to ask another crew for rescue and return home.

films.title: Moon Postcard
films.overview: 一名被困在月球基地的工程师，通过发给家人的短讯等待另一艘飞船接她回家。

films.title: Borrowed Morning
films.overview: A musician wakes into the same day again and again. She changes small decisions on each repetition to recover a lost friendship and understand her memories.

films.title: Paper Lives
films.overview: 一个人每天在梦境中重新经历同一天。他逐次改变选择，试图找回朋友，并分清自己的记忆和梦境。

films.title: Lighthouse Letters
films.overview: An estranged father and adult daughter exchange letters while restoring a coastal lighthouse. Their messages slowly repair the family relationship.

films.title: Quiet Platform
films.overview: 两名年轻人每天乘同一班火车上学，在站台上的短暂相遇中逐渐相爱，毕业后各自决定未来的生活。

films.title: Bridge After Rain
films.overview: After a war ends, a displaced family crosses a ruined bridge to return to their village and search for missing relatives. The story follows recovery rather than battlefield action.

films.title: Shared Orchard
films.overview: 几位童年朋友重回乡村，合作修复荒废的果园。他们在共同劳动中重新理解彼此，决定如何维系友情。
